title: CAISO OASIS LMPs: day-ahead hourly (PRC_LMP DAM) and 15-minute real-time (PRC_RTPD_LMP RTPD) for trading hubs, PACE (ELAP/DGAP), WEIM ELAPs and CAISO DLAPs

notes: OASIS keeps ~39 months online: the earliest DAM day available on 2026-10-27 was 2023-07-16, so 2022-01..2023-07-15 is not reachable here. PACE day-ahead prices exist only since EDAM go-live (2026), inside the sealed test window. Intervals are UTC (INTERVALSTARTTIME_GMT).
